quest.title: Long-Sealed Mystery
quest.description: The well-respected young detective suddenly receives a complaint. You wonder what the story behind it is...

chapter.num: Hangout Event: Shikanoin Heizou - Act I
chapter.title: Trap 'Em by Storm

talks.objective: Go to Bantan Sango Detective Agency

dialogues.speaker: Shiroyama's Testament
dialogues.text: "I murdered Takatsukasa Isamu. I poisoned his cold medicine."

dialogues.speaker: Shiroyama's Testament
dialogues.text: "Though he appeared to be honest and honorable in public, in secret, he asked me to search out a new type of poison to get rid of those who opposed him."

dialogues.speaker: Shiroyama's Testament
dialogues.text: "He also said that if I refused, he would have me thrown in prison. He used my family to blackmail me."

dialogues.speaker: Shiroyama's Testament
dialogues.text: "He left me with no choice. I killed him with a new type of poison that I had someone purchase for me at the International Trade Association... To protect myself, I later framed my colleague Ryuuji."

dialogues.speaker: Shiroyama's Testament
dialogues.text: "But now it's only a matter of time before the detective uncovers everything. I know that I've made a big mistake, and that there's no escaping it now. Only death awaits me. I merely ask that my family be spared."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, this is the key to proving that Shiroyama was the murderer, right? That is, if he was telling the truth, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Shiroyama
dialogues.text: The suspect, Shiroyama, 22 years old, forensic doctor, a subordinate of the deceased, Takatsukasa Isamu.

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Shiroyama
dialogues.text: Shiroyama grew to resent his boss, Takatsukasa Isamu, following conflict at work. He then secretly bought a bottle of poison to kill him in revenge.

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Shiroyama
dialogues.text: Unused poison was later found in the suspect Shiroyama's office. In his testament, he confessed to having planted the poison found in Ryuuji's house.

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Shiroyama
dialogues.text: For the crime of premeditated murder, Shiroyama is hereby sentenced to death. Punishment cannot be carried out as the suspect ended his own life before the execution could take place. This file shall be kept as evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Shiroyama
dialogues.text: Signed: Kujou Sara

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? So Shiroyama's conviction was also signed by Kujou Sara... just like Ryuuji's!

dialogues.speaker: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
dialogues.text: The deceased, Takatsukasa Isamu, 41 years old, Police Station manager.

dialogues.speaker: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
dialogues.text: Clothes intact at time of death. No visible trauma observed on the body, no sign of a struggle. The throat was congested and swollen, caused by a cold before his death.

dialogues.speaker: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
dialogues.text: Local ulceration was found in the stomach and intestines, caused by a novel toxin found in the stomach contents. Stomach contents include: partially undigested soft rice residue; ...

dialogues.speaker: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
dialogues.text: ...small volume of fish-liver paste residue, the main ingredient of which is highly-concentrated fish-liver extract, a valuable nutritional supplement; ...

dialogues.speaker: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
dialogues.text: ...small volume of cold medicine residue containing a large amount of acidic fruit and vegetable extracts. Appears to be a specially prepared medicine from the Office of Forensic Science; ...

dialogues.speaker: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
dialogues.text: ...small volume of novel toxin residue, which was found to be the same toxin discovered in the homes of Ryuuji and Shiroyama. Cause of death: abdominal mucous membrane disease plus respiratory and circulatory failure triggered by the novel toxin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes... he ate all kinds of stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Ryuuji
dialogues.text: The suspect, Ryuuji, 20 years old, Doushin, a subordinate of the deceased, Takatsukasa Isamu.

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Ryuuji grew to resent his boss, Takatsukasa Isamu, following conflict at work. He then secretly bought a bottle of poison to kill him in revenge.

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Unused poison was later found in the suspect Ryuuji's house. For the crime of premeditated murder, Ryuuji is ordered to remain in temporary incarceration awaiting trial. This file shall be kept as evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Conviction of Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Signed: Kujou Sara

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Ryuuji's conviction really was signed by Kujou Sara... But now we know she had it wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Toxicology Report
dialogues.text: On the toxin that caused Takatsukasa Isamu's death:

dialogues.speaker: Toxicology Report
dialogues.text: An odorless, tasteless, and inert substance. Soluble in water, but insoluble in other substances. Has the properties of a synthetic toxin. It appears as a fine, white, powdery substance in its normal state. Tentative name: "white powder."

dialogues.speaker: Toxicology Report
dialogues.text: The station has investigated the ledgers of all domestic commerce guilds, no transaction record for such an item was found.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, a synthetic toxin? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji's Testimony
dialogues.text: "A week before the incident, Master Takatsukasa Isamu caught a cold and lost his appetite. Rice was all he could eat and he had been taking some special cold medicine."

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji's Testimony
dialogues.text: "The night before the incident, he had yet to recover and was still busy with his work, so I was worried about his health. When Dr. Shiroyama came to deliver the medicine, I consulted him about a health supplement."

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji's Testimony
dialogues.text: "Dr. Shiroyama said fish-liver paste could help boost his immune system, so I went to the forensic office to retrieve some and gave it to Master Takatsukasa..."

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji's Testimony
dialogues.text: "But by the next day... Really, Master Takatsukasa was so kind to me, I swear I wouldn't ever do that to him!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, come to think of it, Shiroyama was a forensic doctor... He could easily pull off something like this.

dialogues.speaker: Research Log from the Office of Forensic Science
dialogues.text: (It's blank. Looks like someone tore out a few pages.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? That's weird, there's nothing here! This must be some of the false information that Heizou told us to look out for.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Isamu's Message
dialogues.text: A note placed with Shiroyama's Testament. After comparing the handwriting, it was confirmed to have been written by the deceased, Takatsukasa Isamu.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Isamu's Message
dialogues.text: "Shiroyama, long time no see. I trust the thing I asked you for is in progress?"

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Isamu's Message
dialogues.text: "I paid a visit to your home today while you weren't around. Thankfully, your wonderful wife welcomed me in... She's a fine woman. A perfect match for you."

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Isamu's Message
dialogues.text: "Your wife is five months pregnant, I believe? Fancy that — my wife too."

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Isamu's Message
dialogues.text: "I took the liberty of returning once more to provide her with some health supplements, even helped administer them to her myself. She was most grateful indeed."

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Isamu's Message
dialogues.text: "You will be equally grateful to me, no doubt? Then don't keep me waiting."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Takatsukasa Isamu seems like a thoughtful person, but something about the tone sounds weird...

talks.objective: Look for Ryuuji at Netsuke no Gen Crafts

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Traveler, I believe you can find out the truth. That Shikanoin is hiding something, I just know it.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Sango and Detective Heizou are both great people, but when they're together, only arguing ensues.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Oh suck it up, Ryuuji.

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler. Investigating a case isn't so easy, is it? Don't worry, I'll tell you all you need to know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About President Sango...

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Hah, Sango? The Takatsukasa Clan really hired an amazing detective, didn't they?

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: She comes to the station to submit applications every now and then, and has been constantly requesting to reinvestigate the Ryuuji Case. But Heizou has always prevented her from doing so. I really didn't expect that she'd go as far as writing a complaint letter, though. Whew, she's relentless.

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: As for why Heizou senpai has been keeping her away from the case, I think he's afraid that Sango would be putting herself in danger. After all, we're talking about the murder of an important man, that can be deep water if you're not careful...

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Sango may run a detective agency, but in the end, she's just an ordinary person.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So are they friends?

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Uh well... not exactly. I've pretty much seen them argue every time they meet. But, Heizou might still consider her as an old friend. I heard that he used to work with Sango.

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Sometimes he'd ask me to hand over less pressing cases to the detective agency. I guess he just wants to support Sango's business.

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Hehe, Heizou senpai is a good person, there's no doubt about that.

dialogues.speaker: Owada
dialogues.text: Don't take anything Uesugi says too seriously. Just nod along...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Takatsukasa Isamu and Ryuuji...

dialogues.speaker: Owada
dialogues.text: Oh, that? Well, let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Owada
dialogues.text: Ryuuji saw Takatsukasa Isamu as his foster father, that's for sure. But I can't say whether Isamu helped Ryuuji without expecting anything in return.

dialogues.speaker: Owada
dialogues.text: After all, Isamu was a resourceful person. A simple and naive person like Ryuuji wouldn't ever be suitable as an adviser, but he could certainly be a loyal and trustworthy aid.

dialogues.speaker: Owada
dialogues.text: Isamu was expecting a child of his own later, but unfortunately he was killed before the child was ever born...

dialogues.speaker: Owada
dialogues.text: Anyway, enough about all that... Aren't you here to investigate the case? You'd better get a move on.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: I am at a loss for words right now... please, just leave me be.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Wait, aren't you going to see Ryuuji?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did Heizou say to you when he left the agency?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Hah, now that I think about it, it's like a slap in the face...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: He said, "Some things will always be more important than the truth."
